title: Dolgorae Specialist Review MCP per-request metadata fragment v1
description: Host-controlled MCP params._meta extension used to correlate one logical external review request across transport reconnect or retry. This field is not part of model-visible tool arguments.
x-invariants: the trusted host generates one UUIDv7 per logical tool invocation and repeats it unchanged on a transport retry
the model cannot read, choose, or override the reference through tool arguments
same reference and same normalized request replay returns the original review identity
same reference with a different normalized request fails with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
connection or stdio-process identity is never used as session continuity
